exposure: Prophylactic antibiotics at the time of intrauterine balloon tamponade (IBT) placement
cohort: Patients who received an IBT from January 1, 2012, to December 12, 2016, with the IBT remaining in place at least 2 hours and no chorioamnionitis present
finding: Prophylactic antibiotics at the time of IBT placement were associated with a reduction in postpartum endometritis.
mod_finding: The majority (65%) of those who did not receive prophylactic antibiotics had a cesarean delivery, and the association between antibiotics and endometritis remained after adjusting for mode of delivery.
